# CleverReach Developers

> CleverReach is an email marketing software provider. The Developer Platform provides REST APIs, Webhooks, and developer tools (SDKs, MCP server) to integrate applications with the CleverReach ecosystem.

Important notes:

- Prefer OAuth2 authentication flows over Personal Access Tokens for non-internal scripts.
- Use Core API (v3) for Receiver, Form, and Mailing CRUD operations.
- Use Flows API exclusively for complex automation rules (THEA).
